release_state: offline draft only; not registered, installed or deployed
format: JSON-compatible YAML, existing QuestionBank class validated in isolation

independent_references.rationale: Target is fixed by the question; frame, invitation and response are distinct stages.
No answer row does not identify which acquisition stage excluded a person.
Random selection within a frame cannot give positive invitation probability to an absent group.
A realized nonselection is compatible with a positive pre-draw inclusion probability.
Only the respondent fraction is observed; random invitations do not identify missing outcomes.
Outcome-dependent response changes composition after random invitation; full outcomes here are a declared simulation audit.
Known group shares fix inter-group composition, conditional on usable within-group rates; they do not remove all selection.
A missing group produces an undefined 0/0 rate; known group share alone cannot identify its outcome rate.
Fixed invitation count does not fix expected response count, cost or representativeness; expectations are not realized guarantees.
Equal budgets may produce different invitation counts; equal expected replies do not identify the sampling or response mechanism.

limitations: QuestionBank format and exact rational arithmetic do not establish equal A/B difficulty or diagnostic performance.
No real-student reading or classroom timing trial has been performed.
These hypothetical concept examples do not reveal formal population outcomes, select an automatic optimal design, or establish causal or inference guarantees.
No student-facing question/answer copies, runtime registration, database writes, deployment, commit or push are performed by this script.
